Welcome to Vanessa Solis' portfolio! This space is designated to share my work from a 1-week crash course on Data Science using R.

I am a fourth-year Neurobiology major at Dominican University with minors in Theology and Chemistry. I decided to enroll in this class because of the relevance of coding in medicine, public health, and research.
